artifact: GRENDEL BC10 fermiophilic-ALP sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: High-statistics publication campaign completed 2026-07-15: 145-point mass grid, 1200000-event high-pT importance-sampled FONLL production pool (tilt scale 5 GeV, 50% nominal mixture, seed 42), 20000 full-branching Pythia8 decay templates per supported mass, exact SensCalc three-body matrix-element reweighting, 60 decay/reconstruction samples per detector-entering ALP, and EVENT_CHUNK=256 memory-bounded acceptance MC.

hypothesis.model: PBC BC10: pseudoscalar ALP with universal SM-fermion couplings
hypothesis.coupling: g_aff = c_f m_f / f with c_f = 1 (BNT arXiv:1708.00443 convention)
hypothesis.convention_note: 1/f here = 2/f_GKOZ (arXiv:2310.03524); map any GKOZ/PBC comparison curve accordingly

physics_inputs.production: b -> s a penguin as B -> K^(i) a summed over the kaon tower (K, K*, K0*, K1, K2*) per GKOZ arXiv:2310.03524; FONLL 14 TeV bottom kinematics (NNPDF4.0 NLO)
physics_inputs.decays: Widths, exclusive branching ratios, and three-body squared matrix elements from arXiv:2501.04525, decoded from pinned SensCalc v1.3.3 inputs; flat three-body Pythia phase space is reweighted by the exact matrix elements, while unstable daughters and partonic channels are processed with Pythia 8.317 using an equal u/d/s surrogate for the two-gluon channel

analysis.reconstruction: shared GRENDEL 4-hit two-track vertex reco + PR #13 selection, imported from higgs/ and hnl/ (timing chi2 with daughter beta = p/E); full exclusive branching mixture is sampled before reconstruction

column_contract.invf_min: lower 1/f edge of the excluded island [GeV^-1]
column_contract.invf_max: upper 1/f edge of the excluded island [GeV^-1]
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass (peak_N < 3), including explicit unsupported pole rows
column_contract.peak_N: signal yield at the optimal coupling (max over the 1/f scan)
column_contract.event_ess_columns: importance-weight effective event counts at the lower edge, peak, and upper edge

topology.finite_threshold_tips: Every adjacent finite sensitive/insensitive transition is closed by log-yield/log-coupling interpolation at N_signal = 3; unsupported pole rows are not bridged.

numerical_validation.interpretation: The direct controls reproduce the low-mass upper edge within 2.0% and independently retain sensitivity at 1.25, 1.40, and 3.20 GeV while rejecting 3.30 GeV. The resonance-induced topology and final closure are therefore not finite-pool artifacts.

closure_note: The 2501 decay model produces five disconnected sensitive grid runs. The first two gaps are the explicitly unsupported eta and eta-prime pole windows. Heavy-pseudoscalar width enhancements suppress the optimized yield below threshold at 1.26-1.39 and 1.42-1.46 GeV, leaving a narrow 1.40-1.41 GeV lobe before the final component reopens at 1.47 GeV. Log-yield interpolation between 3.28 and 3.30 GeV places the final central closure at 3.2930 GeV.
